name: Education
title: Educate, Empower, Transform.
tagline: Provide school uniforms, textbooks, digital learning, and tuition to underprivileged children.

impactNotes.200: ₹200 / month sponsors notebook sets, pens, and study stationery for an underprivileged child.
impactNotes.500: ₹500 / month funds school kit, textbooks, uniform and educational support for 1 child.
impactNotes.1000: ₹1,000 / month sponsors full schooling and remedial evening coaching for 2 children.
impactNotes.5000: ₹5,000 / month supports complete digital classroom access and fees for 10 children.
impactNotes.default: Every monthly rupee provides quality education and a brighter tomorrow for underprivileged children.

name: Healthcare
title: Healing Lives, Restoring Dignity.
tagline: Deliver critical medicines, mobile clinic checkups, diagnostic tests, and emergency medical aid to vulnerable families.

impactNotes.500: ₹500 / month provides essential chronic medicines and physician checkup for 1 destitute patient.
impactNotes.1000: ₹1,000 / month covers diagnostic tests, medical consultations, and first-aid kits.
impactNotes.5000: ₹5,000 / month sponsors life-saving emergency medical aid and pediatric care.
impactNotes.default: Your monthly healthcare contribution provides immediate medical attention and relief to vulnerable lives.

name: Food & Nutrition
title: No One Sleeps Hungry.
tagline: Supply wholesome 15-item monthly dry grocery ration kits and daily hot cooked nutritious meals to daily wage workers and children.

impactNotes.500: ₹500 / month delivers a wholesome 15-item dry ration grocery packet feeding a needy family.
impactNotes.1000: ₹1,000 / month delivers full grocery ration plus daily hot cooked nutritious meals.
impactNotes.5000: ₹5,000 / month serves 125+ freshly cooked hot nutritious meals to street children.
impactNotes.default: Your recurring monthly meal donation ensures hunger is eliminated one plate at a time.
